verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any bulk-edit, multi-select, or batch-mutation capability for acting on many issues at once. The GraphQL API and SDK are developer building blocks a user could script against, which earns no credit. Loops and agent features act on individual documents or issues per trigger, not as bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
